status: asset_built; identity/address crosswalk has a documented GIS label conflict

identity_resolution.current_official_chapter_address: 1051 David Ross Road, West Lafayette, IN 47906
identity_resolution.primary_current_source: Purdue BoilerLink Alpha Epsilon Pi chapter profile; current chapter listing
identity_resolution.source_observation: Retrieved 2026-10-26. BoilerLink reports 1051 David Ross Road and chapter email president.aepipu@gmail.com; this establishes the current official chapter address, not independent photographic proof of occupancy at a roof.
identity_resolution.crosswalk_basis: The current chapter address matches the official GIS FID 754 ADDRESS field, and the 60-vertex FID 754 polygon overlays a roof in current Esri World Imagery. Together these support FID 754 as the current-address building candidate. The dated Purdue AEPi photo supports historic facade style only. No recent direct chapter image conclusively resolves which group occupies the roof today.
identity_resolution.physical_footprint_used: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0, FID 754. Its ADDRESS field is 1051 David Ross Rd and its polygon overlays the roof visible in current Esri World Imagery tiles.
identity_resolution.unresolved_name_conflict: The same official GIS feature is named Chi Phi, not Alpha Epsilon Pi. The current chapter address, matching official GIS address, and imagery footprint alignment support an address-based crosswalk, but the conflicting GIS name and lack of current direct occupancy imagery remain unresolved.
identity_resolution.legacy_candidate_not_used: FID 821 is labeled Alpha Epsilon Pi at 116 Fowler Ave. It is a distinct location (about 2.4 km southeast of FID 754) and the imagery tile shows a different, larger roof under/adjacent to the small FID 821 polygon. It is retained as a legacy/candidate record, not accepted as the current house.
identity_resolution.bad_geocoder_pin: OSM/Nominatim returns 1051 David Ross Rd at 40.4350240,-86.9251902, about 115.6 m from the FID 754 footprint centroid. This pin falls near the FID 763 / 951 David Ross GIS row and is not used for building placement.

sources.source_date: tile vintage not exposed in tile response
sources.method: Map tiles assembled and overlaid with source GIS polygon vertices; a separate tile overlay was made for FID821.

sources.evidence: Image caption identifies Purdue AEPi house. Visual cues: brick-clad three-story facade, Greek letters, bay windows with window AC units, shingled mansard roof, shrubs. Historic facade/style evidence only; it does not verify current occupancy or present-day conditions at FID 754.
Address geocoder placement was checked and rejected because it is separated from FID754 roof by approximately 115.6 m.

geometry.source_geometry: official FID 754 polygon, 60 unique vertices; 2D rings translated to local east/north coordinates

projected_metrics.crs: approximate Purdue local tangent frame, not survey-grade
projected_metrics.source_shape_field_unit_note: Official Shape__Area/Shape__Length fields do not numerically match the projected polygon area/perimeter; their units/scale are not used for metric model dimensions.

exterior.measured: Footprint is translated from the official FID 754 ring; model retains 60 source vertices. Local outline bounds approximately 31.34 m by 35.00 m.
exterior.estimated: Three 3.12 m stories inferred from the 2009 exterior photo; total wall height 9.36 m. Mansard eave/break/cap are set at 9.48/11.03/12.38 m using an offset roof geometry, for a final roof cap about 12.48 m. Window count/rhythm, entry canopy/steps, chimney and landscape are visual estimates.
exterior.materials: Warm red brick uses a running-bond Brick Texture on the wall mesh's physical-meter UV course layer (U follows the footprint perimeter and V follows wall height), with restrained mortar relief; limestone trim/sills, charcoal mansard shingles, blue-gray glass and walnut doors use procedural shaders packed in the blend.

interior.status: representative and unverified; no publicly sourced plan located
interior.contents: entry lobby, common lounge, dining, service kitchen, stair circulation, upper-level bedrooms, desks and shared lounges
interior.caveat: room count, floor area subdivisions, positions and furnishings are illustrative fraternity-house programming; no architectural plan or interior photo was used.

refinement_rounds.changes: Corrected material-node lookup to target the Brick Texture node by type, connected the wall's active meter-based UV course layer directly to the texture, and tuned brick proportions, colors and relief to read as horizontal masonry. Smoothed the shared wall mesh vertices while retaining the exact source foundation polygon; expanded bay placement to suitable side/rear edges; replaced boxy entry shrubs with rounded foliage. Refreshed the comparable three-quarter exterior preview and saved a separately named revision copy for review.
refinement_rounds.identity_note: BoilerLink address, FID 754 address and current imagery roof overlay support an address-based candidate crosswalk; the GIS Chi Phi label and absent current direct occupancy image remain unresolved.
